label: TP
reason: Both alerts represent genuine vulnerabilities. Alert 1 (insecure-randomness): java.util.Random() is used to generate rememberMeKey which is stored in cookies/session - not cryptographically secure. Alert 2 (XSS): User-provided cookie values from getCookies() flow directly into response.getWriter() without HTML encoding, enabling script injection. Both issues are present in the code.

evidence.note: java.util.Random() generates insecure randomness used for rememberMeKey
Cookie values from user (via getCookies()) are concatenated into response without HTML encoding
